evidence.quote: Standard period of study 8 semesters (incl. Industrial Internship and Bachelor Thesis), 240 ECTS
Language of instruction English and German
The fees for international students from non-EU countries amount to €1,500 per semester.
Registration deadline for the winter term: 30 September 2026

notes: APS certificate required for applicants from Morocco. The curriculum vitae is listed under academic admission requirements, but it is unclear if it is mandatory for this programme.

note.fr: Vérifiez si un certificat APS (pour le Maroc) est requis pour votre candidature.
note.en: Check if an APS certificate (for Morocco) is required for your application.

evidence.quote: International applicants require a certificate assessment (APS certificate, VPD from uniassist or evaluation of the ZAB).

note.fr: Des connaissances de base en mathématiques et en sciences au niveau scolaire sont attendues au début du programme.
note.en: Basic knowledge of mathematics and science at school level is expected at the start of the programme.

evidence.quote: We do not expect any special prior knowledge at the start of the course, just a basic knowledge of mathematics and science at school level and a command of English (level B2).
